candidateDcc.revision: Replaced original repeated cable-stayed frame (1536 triangles) with a single open tidal water conduit (288 triangles) physically connecting the R5 powerhouse and R6 lift, and replaced the R8F Road6 multi-bay repetitive hall roof with a single folded roof over 2 real turbine bodies.

trueCameraComparison.comparison: Same native original source camera and tick, same K4CS legacy-noncolliding-visual-gate suppression used in R8B/R8E/R8F, RAW PNG not separate concept renders.
trueCameraComparison.imagePixelDiffMethod: RGB max-channel absolute difference greater than 25, only original game viewport x15:990,y80:500 (1365x930 full screenshot). Values below are percentage of changed pixels, NOT art scores.

observation.at65_25: The repeatedly braced struts are somewhat simplified on the visible left, but the road/right bank and the larger overall composition remain visually cluttered and low-poly.
observation.at66_35: Clearer service channel silhouette at left of center than the older heavy lattice, but minimal change to road and right-bank composition.
observation.at68_05: Single large pale flat roof fan replaces repeated roofing; a structural simplification, yet produces a blunt faceted sheet that weakens industrial depth. No reliable overall art upgrade established.

positives: Reduced actual scene triangles while keeping original 3D world, game physics and all 43 editable functional groups.
Replaced 1,536-triangle repeated truss with 288-triangle continuous functionally connected water conduit.
A testable single terminal roof concept that differs from the repeated open hall.
failures: 65s original left skyline remains busy and material treatment still flat.
66s visual changes touch a small portion of the environment; hazard legibility still not proven for people.
68s new roof becomes a broad pale planar wedge, reads as simple polygonal mass rather than convincing operating plant.
Current original game graphics lack atmospheric/lighting/site context and distinctive large-scale composition; no world-class ART evidence.
criticalArchitectureAssessment.selectedComparisonBaseline: R8E TRUE SOURCE CLEAN RAW, R8F/R8G are retained as separate unpromoted research hypotheses
criticalArchitectureAssessment.candidateDisposition: Research branch experiment preserved with history; no formal ART promotion, merge, or release. Next design must avoid generic repeated frames and broad blank planes.
criticalArchitectureAssessment.prohibitedConclusion: Do not infer human hazard cue fairness, full FPS/SAT/CCD certification, or actual B51 collision response from successful near miss.

nextDevelopment: Instead of another bar/roof/surface grain mutation, form a real art-direction pass. Target redesign of dominant source chase left skyline, cliff geology/tidal water lighting and the B51 warning visual hierarchy with real playable view; measure at fixed 65.25/66.35/68.05s. Keep research proposals separate, no formal adoption until comparative ART and real-human tests.
